page_title: RAY 2-1 GRA | Rayo Vallecano v Granada CF 15/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' The referee points to the corner flag and Rayo Vallecano will take a corner.

90+6' Nice individual effort by Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a shot to the left side of the goal, but Marc Martinez does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
90+5' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+3' Granada CF have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+2' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera had an easy-decision to make.
90+2' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is flagged for offside.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Carlos Neva (Granada CF) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
89' 2 - 1 GOAL! Lucas Boye (Granada CF) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Sergio Rodelas provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 2:1.
88' Here is a change. Alvaro Garcia is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
88' Substitution. Isi Palazon walks off the pitch and Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as a substitute.
85' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
85' Carlos Neva (Granada CF) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
83' Granada CF take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
83' The referee can't ignore those comments and Jose Callejon (Granada CF) sees a yellow card for bad language.
83' Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Rayo Vallecano players have a reason to celebrate!
82' Celebrations by Rayo Vallecano are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
80' 2 - 0 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 2:0.
80' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
78' A substitution has been made. Oscar Valentin is replaced by Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano).
78' Isidro Diaz de Mera couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Matias Arezo (Granada CF) and blew his whistle.
77' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is able to continue to play.
76' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' Sergio Rodelas (Granada CF) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
75' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
74' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
73' Raul Torrente comes off the pitch to be replaced by Sergio Rodelas (Granada CF).
71' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the left post.
70' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 12:5.
66' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
65' A substitution has been made. Sergio Camello goes off and Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
63' The ball is crossed into the box and Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) reacts quickest to send a shot flying low towards the middle of the goal, but Marc Martinez gets a glove on it to thwart him.
62' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera saw the whole situation.
61' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) is adjudged offside.
60' Jose Ramon Sandoval has decided to substitute Sergio Ruiz and he is replaced by Matias Arezo (Granada CF).
59' Marc Martinez pulls off a decent save to deny a dangerous free kick from the edge of the box, which was executed by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano). The ball flew low towards the middle of the goal.
58' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle and it's Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
57' Granada CF quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
57' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
57' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
56' Dangerous play by Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF). Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Wasted effort! Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
53' Granada CF fail to score from a corner as Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) leaps to collect the ball.
52' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
51' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Isidro Diaz de Mera signals.
48' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
47' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
47' The attendance for today's match is 12738.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Theodor Corbeanu (Granada CF) comes off for Jose Callejon.
46' Jose Ramon Sandoval has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Gonzalo Villar comes on the pitch for Oscar Melendo (Granada CF).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Inigo Perez probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano). He is replaced by Miguel Crespo.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) sends a cross into the box, but Stole Dimitrievski comes off his line to gather the ball.
45+4' Carlos Neva (Granada CF) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+4' The game is interrupted now, Carlos Neva (Granada CF) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45+3' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post.
45+1' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The ball rebounds to Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
44' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) will take a corner kick.
44' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
43' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' Theodor Corbeanu (Granada CF) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
42' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
42' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
41' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
37' The game is interrupted as Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) is flagged offside.
37' A clumsy foul by Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle.
34' 6:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
31' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
30' Granada CF hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle and signals a foul after Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) brought his opponent down.
26' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.

25' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Marc Martinez pulls off a brilliant save.
23' 1 - 0 Goal! Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:0.
23' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Marc Martinez.
23' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
22' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Marc Martinez to dive and make a save.
22' Foul! Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
21' Isidro Diaz de Mera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF).
19' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
17' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' A pass by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
13' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marc Martinez intercepts the ball.
13' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

12' Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
12' Now Granada CF have a corner.
11' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
9' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post.
7' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
6' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
5' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera had no choice but to send Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) off. VAR seen to good effect there!
4' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano)! Let's see what he decides.
3' The game has begun to heat up. Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
2' Rayo Vallecano work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
2' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
1' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
1' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
1' The match has just started.
Rayo Vallecano will kick-off.
Isidro Diaz de Mera will supervise the game today.
